meta.title: MateOS · One OS runs the whole process
meta.description: MateOS is the operating layer over the ERP, CRM and mailboxes you already run: access, monitoring, rules, an exception desk and a learning loop. No new screen. A person wherever it’s needed.

hero.lead: Give Mate a number and a date. Mate builds the flows in the systems you already run, and checks the number every day.

backwards.title: Built backwards, on purpose.
backwards.lead: Most projects start with tools and work up to the number. Mate starts with the number and works down.
backwards.toggleLabel: Compare the old way with the MateOS way

title: Other AI answers questions.
Mate does the work.
surfaces.lead: No new screen. Your team keeps working in the ERP, the mailbox, WhatsApp and Excel.

loop.title: Every exception becomes a rule.
loop.lead: Solve an exception once and it stays solved. The system learns your business, not the other way round.

control.title: You stay in charge.
facts: Mate automates the routine. A named person approves what matters.
Write access only if you decide, per system.
Your cloud tenant, your DMZ or on-prem.
Your rules and records stay with you.
A person you can call, always.
Mate works behind the scenes. People stay in the room.

faq.title: Questions owners ask.
qs: It stops and asks the person you name. Their answer can become a rule.
What if it makes a mistake?
In a pilot, a person approves every output first. A stop rule, agreed up front, pauses it. Approval steps come off only where the numbers say it is safe.
